name: summary_df
description: At-a-glance risk view: moments + key percentiles (Freq/Sev/Agg)
notes: WRINKLE: PnL = FCC headline, FIXED shape EX/Scaled/SD/CV/Skew/P1/Median/P99 (a123; build('pnl') always returns PnL); Reinst/VarRt = Gross/Ceded/Net/Impact headline on the attached .analysis (VarRt gained a122); Agg/Port = moments+percentiles (a113); Biv = theory-vs-realised.

name: tail_df
description: Return-period / exceedance table (p VaR TVaR xsVaR VaR/Mean)
notes: WRINKLE: Agg/Port = return-period table, METHOD. Biv = per-axis support, PROPERTY. Reinst/VarRt = net-UW return-period, METHOD (VarRt gained a122). PnL: none.

name: validation_df
description: Moment-vs-estimate QA table (theory vs FFT estimate, rel error)
notes: a113 rename of old summary_df. Biv keeps its validation inside summary_df (not migrated).

name: tail_behavior_df
description: Layered tail report: support + per-side tail class + concentration
notes: a113 rename of old tail_df.

name: stats_df
description: Single source of truth for moments (component x measure x view)
notes: Canonical moment store; summary_df/validation_df read from it. On PnL it is a PROPERTY over the P&L legs -- fixed layout, stats x (leg, value/Scaled), scale committed at construction (a123, was a method a122).

name: density_df
notes: The realised PMF grid + derived columns. On PnL it is an ordered {leg: GridDistribution} dict, not a single frame (a122).

name: density
notes: WRINKLE: VariableRatingAnalysis.density is the INPUT gross-density array, not the density_df live slice -- name collision.

name: sev_density_df
description: Per-bucket severity density on the severity grid
notes: Severity-grid analogue of density_df.

name: bs_window_df
notes: Grid-selection audit; None before update.

name: result
description: The net (result) leg distribution of a P&L
notes: The exact net GridDistribution (replaces pnl_df, a122); q/cdf/sf/mean/sd/prob_loss delegate to it.

name: gcn_df
description: Gross/Ceded/Net waterfall (stats x perspective; means add)
notes: New-canonical stats x waterfall (a122). Also on PnLTower (no CSV column). Not on the plain PnL value object; a PnL surfaces it as margin_df (a123).

name: margin_df
description: Gross/Ceded/Net margin waterfall (stats x perspective; means add)
notes: a123; forwards the attached tower/analysis gcn_df. A plain PnL has no cession -> raises.

name: dependency_df
description: Joint dependence (cov / corr / tau) by level
notes: Bivariate-only.

name: reins_summary_df

name: reins_stats_df

name: reins_density_df
